items.title: Internal file and communication system
items.summary: Internal platform with its own authentication, file management and communication.
items.role: Technical leadership of a 6-person team developing the platform.
items.solution: Internal platform that brings its own authentication, file management and communication together in a single system.
items.result: Platform with authentication, file management and communication.

items.title: Hotelbeds automation
items.summary: Automation of financial entries to reduce the team's manual work.
items.solution: Automation of financial entries with data integration, replacing manual steps for the team.
items.result: Saves the team 16 hours a week.

items.title: Internal management mobile app
items.summary: Corporate app focused on centralizing internal processes.
items.role: Development of screens, reusable components and navigation flows.
items.solution: App interface and navigation flows, prepared for integration with the internal system's REST APIs.
items.result: App screens, components and navigation flows.

items.title: Virtual card data automation and reconciliation
items.summary: Automation and reconciliation of financial data using Cielo and Hunit.
items.role: Development of dashboards and controls to track charges, identify discrepancies and support financial management.
items.solution: Automated reconciliation of virtual card data with tracking dashboards and controls.
items.result: Tracking of charges and identification of discrepancies.

items.title: Cash process automation
items.summary: Standardization and automation of the cash process.
items.solution: Standardized cash process steps, with validation and financial automation.
items.result: Saves about 8 hours every two weeks.

items.title: Billing and card BI
items.summary: Operational dashboards used daily for billing and card control.
items.role: Dashboard creation and support in identifying a financial gap.
items.solution: Power BI dashboards with data modeling and financial indicators for daily monitoring.
items.result: Helped identify a R$ 3 million financial gap, which was referred for resolution.

items.title: Invoice entry form
items.summary: Application with a front-end interface that simplifies invoice entry and control.
items.solution: Front-end interface integrated with the backend to register and control invoices.
